page.notes: The left margin carries only faint show-through from the reverse side and no printed notes. Several lines at the left edge are cut off by the gutter. The line "sacipuè conuenit" and the head "SANCTIS[?]" are doubtful readings. Words at the left edge of lines 6 to 9 of the second paragraph are partly lost in the binding shadow, so the gaps in the transcribed text were filled only where the letters are legible.
